name: scheduler
summary: A composite recurrence builder. A 'Scheduler Type' segmented control (MRadioGroup as-button: Once · Daily · Weekly · Monthly) swaps in a sub-form. Once/Daily = Start Date + Hours; Weekly adds Days (Mon-Sun); Monthly adds Months + Dates (1-31). Hours = the custom dropdown TimePicker (multi-select times); Days/Months/Dates = FlotoDropdownPicker multi-selects; Start Date = MDatePicker (date-only, min-date today). Used for backups, network discovery, compliance audits, monitor (re)discovery, reports, runbooks.

usage.renders: REFERENCE REPRODUCTION in Storybook — importing the real ScheduleInput pulls the local DB (lokijs -> Node fs), so it can't render live (like TimeRangePicker / the Kendo grid). Reproduced from the REAL primitives (MRadioGroup as-button + MDatePicker + FlotoDropdownPicker).

scheduleTypes.Daily: every day — Start Date + Hours (same sub-form as Once)
scheduleTypes.Monthly: Months (Jan-Dec multi) + Dates (1-31 multi) + Start Date + Hours

excludedScheduleOptions.note: drop schedule types from the segmented control, e.g. ['Weekly','Monthly'] (1x)

showOnlyOnce.note: collapse to the Once type only (no recurrence) (1x)

ScheduleInput.$attrs: passed to the sub-form: disabled (2x), time-options (2x), use-single-selection (1x), hide-date-time (1x), multiple

subForms.timeOptions: array — override the Hours options (external-options on the TimePicker)
subForms.multiple: bool — allow multiple Hours (use-single-selection caps to 1)

emit: change -> { scheduleType:'Once'|'Daily'|'Weekly'|'Monthly', scheduleInfo: { startDate:<ms>, times:[…], days:[…](weekly), months:[…]+dates:[…](monthly) } }. On type change, scheduleInfo resets to { startDate: now }.
builtFrom: custom TimePicker (time-picker.vue, a FlotoDropdownPicker of times, multiple) — Hours
decisionFlow: Need a RECURRING schedule (run X every day/week/month)? -> ScheduleInput.
Just a date or date+time value (not a recurrence)? -> MDatePicker (Date & Time Pickers family), not this.
A chart/dashboard TIME WINDOW? -> TimeRangePicker, not this.

recurring.useWhen: a job runs on a recurrence
recurring.example: nightly backup, weekly compliance audit, monthly report

restrictTypes.example: a feature that only supports Daily/Weekly

Once.useWhen: The job runs exactly one time at a chosen Start Date and Hours, with no recurrence. Reach it either from the segmented type control or by collapsing the whole component to this type with :show-only-once when recurrence never applies.
Once.dontUse: Don't use when the job should repeat on any cadence (use Daily/Weekly/Monthly), and don't use it as a plain date/time value picker inside a form — that's MDatePicker.
Once.example: A one-time, non-recurring network discovery run in discovery-schedules (ScheduleInput with :show-only-once collapsing to the Once sub-form: Start Date + Hours).

Daily.useWhen: The job repeats every day at one or more selected Hours from the Start Date onward — the simplest recurring cadence (same sub-form as Once: Start Date + Hours).
Daily.dontUse: Don't use when the job should only run on certain weekdays (use Weekly) or on specific calendar dates/months (use Monthly), and don't use for a single non-repeating run (use Once / :show-only-once).
Daily.example: A nightly device-config backup in backup-profile-form / device-inventory-schedule-backup, set to run every day at the chosen hour.

Weekly.useWhen: The job repeats on specific weekdays — adds a Days (Mon–Sun) multi-select (FlotoDropdownPicker) on top of Start Date + Hours.
Weekly.dontUse: Don't use when the job runs every day regardless of weekday (use Daily) or when it must land on specific calendar dates within chosen months (use Monthly).
Weekly.example: A weekly compliance audit in compliance-audit-schedules that runs on selected weekdays (e.g. Mon/Wed/Fri) at a set hour.

Monthly.useWhen: The job repeats on specific calendar dates within chosen months — adds Months (Jan–Dec) and Dates (1–31) multi-selects (FlotoDropdownPicker) on top of Start Date + Hours.
Monthly.dontUse: Don't use when a weekday cadence is enough (use Weekly) or a plain every-day/one-off run suffices (use Daily/Once); don't overload it for chart time windows (that's TimeRangePicker).
Monthly.example: A monthly compliance/report run in report-form or compliance-audit-schedules scheduled for specific dates (e.g. the 1st) across selected months.

do: Use for recurring jobs (backups, discovery, audits, reports).
Use :show-only-once for a single non-recurring run.
Keep it inside a form (FlotoFormItem fields are required).
dont: Don't use it for a plain date/time value — that's MDatePicker.
Don't use it for a chart time window — that's TimeRangePicker.
Don't hand-roll a Once/Daily/Weekly/Monthly switcher — reuse ScheduleInput.

F1.issue: The three sub-forms (once/weekly/monthly-input.vue) all carry name:'OnceForm' — a copy-paste leftover; harmless but should be unique.

F2.issue: ScheduleInput pulls the local DB (lokijs) transitively, so it can't render in Storybook — reproduced from primitives.

accessibility.providedBy: MRadioGroup (radio semantics / arrow-key selection for the type), MDatePicker / FlotoDropdownPicker (their own a11y), FlotoFormItem (labels + required/validation).
accessibility.verify: Each field has a visible label (it does, via FlotoFormItem); focus-visible ring (SF-001) on the segmented buttons + selects.

scopedOut.MetricPollTime / metric-collection-time: metric POLLING-FREQUENCY config (a separate monitoring sub-system) — not a job recurrence; candidate for a future Monitoring-config entry.
scopedOut.monitor-schedules.vue (MonitorSchedule): a CRUD LIST view of schedules (on/off windows); edits via monitor-schedule-form which uses ScheduleInput — a consumer, not a new component.
scopedOut.'Hourly' type: a granularity dropdown in policy anomaly/forecast conditions (aggregation period), NOT a ScheduleInput recurrence type. ScheduleInput types are Once/Daily/Weekly/Monthly only.
scopedOut.NotifyTimePicker / date-remark-pairs: notification-timing / holiday-list composites — out of scope.

events.ScheduleInput.change: (value) — emits the full schedule object `{ scheduleType, scheduleInfo }`; this is the v-model event.

slots: none — a segmented schedule-type control (Once / Daily / Weekly / Monthly) + the matching sub-form; no slots.

a11y.summary: Type = MRadioGroup (radio semantics); date = MDatePicker (input + calendar, Esc); dropdowns = FlotoDropdownPicker (searchable/keyboard); every field wrapped in FlotoFormItem (label + required).
issues: SF-001 focus-visible on the segmented control.
Type change swaps fields — verify focus lands sensibly.
a11y.$note: Catalogue-wide gap SF-001 = no visible :focus-visible ring; tracked in findings/.
